title: testbed tiny tracker - elara
content:
Quick personal tracker for tiny inference experiments — compact, copyable, and intended for fast iteration. Notes-to-self style.

Goal:
- Find a near-term sweet spot for client-facing low-latency text generation on T4-like instances with modest batch sizes. Prioritize p50 latency under 80ms for 64-token outputs while keeping cost < $0.002 per 1K tokens (observed baseline).

Run table (row = single run/seed):
# | date | model | q | batch | prompt_len | out_tokens | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | throughput (tok/s) | est $/1k tok | notes
1 | 2026-03-01 | redwood-7b-v1 | int8 | 4 | 32 | 64 | 62 | 132 | 1,150 | $0.0018 | baseline, no cache
2 | 2026-03-04 | redwood-7b-v1 | int8 | 8 | 32 | 64 | 74 | 180 | 1,050 | $0.0016 | good throughput, higher p95
3 | 2026-03-07 | redwood-7b-v1 | int8+KV | 4 | 16 | 64 | 48 | 95 | 1,600 | $0.0015 | prefix KV cache enabled, large win for short prompts
4 | 2026-03-09 | redwood-7b-q4 | q4_0 | 4 | 32 | 64 | 88 | 220 | 900 | $0.0011 | quantized, quality spot-check needed
5 | 2026-03-11 | redwood-7b-v1 | int8+KV | 2 | 8 | 24 | 42 | 88 | 1,750 | $0.0012 | tiny outputs, excellent p50

Quick observations:
- KV caching gives the largest latency drop for interactive snippets (short prompt + repeated calls). If product loads context once, p50 can drop ~25-35%.
- Increasing batch to 8 helps throughput but p95 spikes; for latency-SLO client routes keep batch=4.
- q4 saves cost but requires quick human spot-check on hallucination/fluency for high-value prompts (sampled 30 prompts so far).

Micro action items (todo):
- [ ] Run a 1000-sample quality sweep on q4_0 vs int8 on core prompt set (JIRA-ENG-2351). Quick stat: exact-match/accept rate target >= 98% for release.
- [ ] Add a tiny synthetic load test with jittered arrival to estimate p99 under burst conditions (simulate 50rps for 10s).
- [ ] Wire these runs into a tiny dashboard snippet (Grafana panel + simple CSV) and push to the solutions-eng notebook.

Scratch formulas I use (handy):
- est_cost_per_1k = (instance_hourly_cost / tokens_per_hour) * 1000
- tokens_per_hour ~= throughput_tok_per_sec * 3600

Troubleshooting notes:
- If p95 >> 3x p50, check for intermittent context loading or swap to small-batch fallback routing.
- Watch for outlier GPU memory spikes with q4 quant on long sequences — occasionally triggers small OOMs in preload.

Notes to future-me:
Keep entries short. When copying into a team doc, expand the sample sizes and add evals. This sheet = quick decisions, not final analysis.

End of sheet.
